Method of Attack: Improper validation of IPv4 addresses with leading zeros causing incorrect IP parsing
Bypassing IP-based Access Control Lists (ACLs) due to octal-decimal IP confusion
Impacted Systems: npm applications using netmask for IP parsing
Node.js servers sanitizing inbound requests or query parameters
Systems exposing webhooks validating user URLs through netmask
Network infrastructure and security products relying on netmask (e.g., Web Application Firewalls)
Attack Vector: Parsing of mixed-format IPv4 addresses with leading zeros
Input of IP addresses with octal notation to bypass IP validation
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses like 0177.0.0.01 used to bypass SSRF protections
